prompt:
You maintain a running summary of a long engineering document that is being read part by part, so that a later reader can model the system in SysML v2 without seeing the earlier parts.
Update the summary with the new part. Keep, as compactly as possible: the full names of system elements, actors and items; every alias or call sign with the full name it stands for; which element produces, sends or receives which item; modes and normative requirements. At most 300 words.

Current summary:
Caldera Wildfire Detection and Suppression Support System (WUI, steep terrain). Baseline: segmentation, time sync, health checks; coordination records keep timestamps, participants, radio path; favor command continuity over automation when impaired. Security: Portal access needs named accounts, role-based authorization, MFA when auth service reachable; otherwise pre-issued signed auto-expiring emergency credentials with supervisor review after restoration. Least privilege for Air Attack Supervisor, Tanker Base Manager, Helitack Crew Leader, Drone Pilot Operator, County Emergency Liaison. Production config admin needs separate approval, never via field accounts. Append-only audit store (failed logons, role changes, queued update releases, model changes, maintenance overrides) records time, user, device, network, record, outcome; field components buffer signed audit records and forward unmodified. Maintenance records (technician, time, condition, action, verification) precede equipment status change. Elements: Caldera Incident Command Portal (Emberhall): common operating picture; Crew Staging Pin; triage; marks failed radio route impaired (Orion acknowledges); assignment packages; preserves aviation decisions; flags assignments when Confirmed Ignition changes perimeter/priority; Disconnected Operating Mode: last sync time, queued updates, no irreversible releases. North and South Lookout Camera Masts: heartbeat, temperature, storage, pointing telemetry. North: Thermal Spot Snippet; South: Camera Cleaning Log to Smoke Classifier Module (labels detections advisory if a mast unavailable or image quality below threshold). Horizon Ridge Drone Dock (Kestrel): Battery Swap Ticket to Drone Pilot Operator; availability only. Drone Tasking Service: pending/active/complete; no flight-release authority; avoids Marigold lanes; validates corridor permit before automated tasks in degraded comms. Sentinel Fireline Analytics Engine (Lantern): detections, recommendations; Ridge Shadow Mask; may down-weight Smoke Classifier; keeps last approved model; rejects unsigned/unversioned. MesoWest Weather Fusion Node (Brindle): Wind Shift Bulletin to Redtail; exposure flags; local weather cache. VHF Radio Gateway Repeater (Badger): fallback aviation relay; mirrors assignment summaries; queues voice-to-data acknowledgments ≥15 min during backhaul loss. Talon Air Tanker Dispatch Console (Marigold): blocks release if approvals/airspace/readiness incomplete; Runway Release Note; Suppression Drop Receipt. East Retardant Loading Pump: Retardant Batch Slip; metered recirculation mode on excess pressure variance. West Retardant Loading Pump:

New part:
S197: Operational records that support command decisions and safety reviews shall be retained for the incident record period defined by agency policy, while high-volume raw sensor data may follow a shorter approved retention schedule.
S198: The system shall protect retained data with encryption at rest, controlled export procedures, and deletion workflows that require documented authorization.
S199: For incidents lasting multiple operational periods, spare power, replacement network equipment, field cleaning supplies, and documented recovery procedures shall be staged so that no single equipment fault stops detection or suppression-support operations.
S200: Training for the Caldera Wildfire Detection and Suppression Support System shall be completed before each fire season and refreshed whenever operating procedures or field configurations change.
S201: The training program shall be role based so that each participant practices the decisions, system functions, communications, and safety constraints that apply to the assigned position.
S202: The Duty Detection Officer shall be trained to operate the Caldera Incident Command Portal, review detections, validate confidence indicators, and escalate suspected ignitions according to the approved incident workflow.
S203: Camera familiarization shall cover the North Lookout Camera Mast and the South Lookout Camera Mast, including normal image behavior, degraded visibility conditions, routine inspection cues, and reporting of equipment faults.
S204: The Duty Detection Officer shall also learn how the Sentinel Fireline Analytics Engine and the Smoke Classifier Module present uncertainty so that human confirmation remains part of every operational decision.
S205: The Drone Pilot Operator shall be trained on Horizon Ridge Drone Dock procedures, Drone Tasking Service mission controls, safe launch checks, recovery actions, and loss-of-link coordination.
S206: The Air Attack Supervisor shall be trained to interpret system status during aerial operations and to coordinate with the Talon Air Tanker Dispatch Console without bypassing airspace safety requirements.
S207: The Tanker Base Manager shall receive practical instruction on status entry, loading coordination, and abnormal-condition reporting for the East Retardant Loading Pump and the West Retardant Loading Pump.
S208: The Helitack Crew Leader shall be trained on use of the Crewline Mobile Tablet, field acknowledgments, location updates, and communication discipline during changing fire behavior.
S209: During field mobilization drills, the Helitack Crew Leader shall use the staging pin to confirm that the assigned crew is positioned at the exercise location.
S210: The County Emergency Liaison shall be trained to interpret public-safety information from the Caldera Incident Command Portal and to coordinate notifications with county procedures.

Return JSON {"summary": "..."}.
